utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Uli — I’ll spread the word and rally a few more neighbors for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’m still checking what we’re short on, and I’ll send you the top priorities soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still taking stock of what we’re short on, and I’ll tell you the top priorities for the repair drive soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word? It’s on Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet — I still don’t have the exact details, but I can check and let you know. It’s headed to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — what time should I expect it at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll see you Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I’m late — did I miss any other repair drive details?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street first — please spread the word, and I’ll keep an ear out for what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll spread the word about Saturday morning at the community center on Oak Street. I’m still waiting on the exact issue, but I’m ready to help once you know what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still don’t know the exact details, but I’m glad to hear it’s coming together. If you’ve got the latest, I’d love the update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the latest details yet either—can you tell me when and where the repair drive is headed? I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the spot where the tools are piled up first. Just point me there, and I’ll keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — let’s start at the spot where the tools are piled up, then we’ll sort the rest from there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need most.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot—could you tell me the most urgent items first so I can keep track?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today — folks are gathering supplies and getting things sorted now. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I can help if you need an extra hand there at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m ready to help on Sunday at the community center—just let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—just send me the exact list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — I’m still sorting the remaining tasks, and I’ll share the list shortly.
